limitations: This report certifies the pinned da74782 workflow run only. Documentation commits and a final metadata-only descendant require their own exact-SHA evidence; lead owns that follow-up.
Source/target equality, preservation of 129 files, final pull, Git state and handover are lead-owned and not certified by this CI report.
Success means 18 required jobs passed, not 19 jobs executed successfully. Publication was intentionally skipped by tag condition.
Six platform packages are not six production-signed, store-ready or physically device-tested releases.
App/Core full suites run on the OHOS Flutter fork. Standard Flutter jobs build other targets, but no independent full root App/Core suite on that SDK is established here.
Core has 27 skipped tests; each companion has one skipped test. Skipped and hidden events are not executed passes.
Assistant and iOS integration exact current test counts are uncollected. Their successful current job conclusions remain valid evidence.
Artifact archive contents and individual installer hashes were not independently opened or recomputed. API digests and size/expiry metadata are recorded exactly.
Strict unchanged-lockfile reproducibility is not claimed; setup may resolve packages and warn on lock drift. Existing plugin/native provenance guards remain required.

The app consumes pinned native Git payloads; it does not rebuild their native source here. Imported producer run 44863517943 failed overall, while pinned plugin run 44867887807 succeeded independently, per prior audit.
The app delegates language execution through InteropRunner; six app installer jobs do not establish sibling language-runtime coverage.
Actions artifacts expire on 2026-12-10 UTC. No release publication or long-term retention is established by this main push.
